note: Hand-drawn non-dune areas for Liwa (WGS84). Drawn by eye on the Landsat 15 m pan images of 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 around every farm cluster as the union of its 2000, 2013 and 2025 extent (walled plots on sand are mostly unvegetated and missed by NDVI/WorldCover), and around structures added after 2000. Megadunes, sabkha flats and the small-dune field are left unmasked. Used only to EXCLUDE areas from dune-motion statistics (and from stable ground). Each polygon states why. Polygons flagged stable_ground = allowed are established walled farms that may still give stable ground (subject to the coherence test); all other polygons are barred from stable ground too.

properties.reason: Farm plots along the western edge (dark irrigated plots in 2000, walled plots with sand inside by 2013-2025): walls and planting change, not dune motion.
properties.drawn_on: Landsat pan B8 2000-11-27, 2013-11-07 and 2025-11-08 (notebook 02 grid, 15 m, viewed at full resolution with a 0.005 deg lon/lat grid)
properties.stable_ground_note: Walled farm plots already in place by 2013 (outline unchanged 2013-2025 by eye): excluded from dune statistics, but windows here may serve as stable ground for co-registration if they pass the coherence test (look alike in every Landsat 8/9 pair). Without them the only automatic stable-ground candidates in this box were live dunes.
